notes: Inbound SMB lead — self-serve signup, wants hosted API only. Peak traffic small: ~10 rps, typical 2-5 rps.
Primary problem: 'EU storefront users see timeouts during checkout chat' — spike window 17:00-20:00 CET.
Observed routing issue: many EU requests were hitting us-east-1; recommend final production region in eu-west-1 or eu-central-1.
- Use eu-west-1 for EU traffic via region-aware routing in client; set fallback to us-east-1 for overflow.
- Streaming: enable response streaming and set client-side idle timeout 2s, server request timeout 8s to avoid premature cancellations.
- Prompt guidance: keep model context to ~512 tokens for chat responses; truncate product descriptions and send embeddings for long docs.
- Batching/Concurrency: concurrency 3-4 for small instances, max_tokens per request 512; enable prefix caching for repeated SKUs.
- Timeouts: recommend 8s server timeout, 2s client idle stream window, retry on 5xx with exponential backoff (start 200ms).
POC plan: 48-hour hosted API run in eu-west-1 (small instance profile). Measure p50/p95, error rate, and cost delta vs us-east-1.
